turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm digging into some QA datasets today. Do you know what MuSiQue is used for?
I can help with that. Could you provide a brief definition or context for what you've read?
Sure. Basically, MuSiQue is a multi-hop QA benchmark used to evaluate Cognition on Graph.
Noted. I've updated your profile with that specific purpose for MuSiQue.
Great. Also, did you see the weather forecast for next week? It looks like rain.
Yes, there is a high chance of precipitation starting Tuesday. You might want to check your umbrella.
Thanks for the reminder. I'll keep that in mind.
Lloyd, I'm looking at the preprocessing steps for MuSiQue now. What's the filtering mechanism?
I don't have the specific technical details stored. Could you share what you've found?
Right. MuSiQue applies disconnection filtering using a Longformer to drop head/tail pairs recoverable without the head.
Understood. I've logged that detail regarding the Longformer filtering process.
Perfect. By the way, did my new monitor stand arrive?
I see a tracking update saying it was delivered to your front door this morning.
Awesome, thanks. I'll go set it up.
